tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal kye rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs ngag 'don snying po gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī he badzrā ya/ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis dpal kye rdo rje gtso rkyang gi mngon rtogs bsgom par 'dod pas/ bde ba'i bstan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ skyabs yul gsal btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ las thod pa dum bu gsum pa dpral bar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de'i g.yon tu am̐ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la am̐ gis mtshan pa/

de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mo thal ka drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/ bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang dgu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje ngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpal kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ zhes brjod cing bsams la lha'i nga rgyal dang gsal snang la sems bzung*/ de nas bzlas pa bya bar 'dod pas/ yum gyi thugs ka'i am̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas 'thon yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste yum gyi padmar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi zhal nas yab kyi zhal du zhugs te rgyun mi chad par 'khor bas bde ba chen po'i ye shes brtan par bsams la/ oṃ aṣṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lordhwa ke sha wartam ne/ tsa turbingsha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dhā ri ṇe/ adhmā ta krū ra tsittā ya/ ardhentu daṃ ṣṭī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardzadza ya gardzadza ya/ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sapta sā ga rā na/ bandha bandha/ nā gāntu kā na/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/

zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs ci nus dang*/ spro na/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥ.am̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kye rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab kyi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dges pa rdo rje 'grub gyur nas sogs dang*/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med kye yi rdo rje ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba// de yis sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang dang snang ba thams cad lha'i 'khor lor shes pas/ zas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad/ nub mo lhar snang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su sbyangs te nyal/ tho rangs lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldangs te lam zab mo'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung las btus te bya bral ba mañdzu gho ṣas bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun dpal he ru ka dges pa rdo rje'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la mngon du byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig/

//maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
